encoder.input: Exact original mono16kHz64000 float32 samples; no normalization, denoising, padding or resampling
encoder.pooling: Layer order4,8,12; each masked population mean then standard deviation; float32
encoder.runtime: CPU float32, eager attention, eval, all parameters frozen; no custom remote code
encoder.weight_terms: Model-card-linked UniSpeech CC-BY-SA-3.0; retain attribution/share-alike. Separate unilm code MIT.

method.change: Replace log-Mel inputs with frozen WavLM hidden states from layers 4, 8 and 12, without changing source roles, the temporal model, objective, speech gate, proposal grid, or operating-point rules.
method.controlled_comparison: Keep identical initialization, losses, fit/calibration/held roles, gates and proposal scoring. Change only the input to the learned boundary output.
method.edge_input: Reuse the content pathway and total parameter count. The boundary output reads the absolute hidden feature difference between 40 ms before and 40 ms after each point, with edge hold. The original one-channel content output still reads the undifferenced state.
method.encoding: One original six-second native mono PCM per call. Match frame centers at 200 + 320i samples. Reduce each 768-wide layer by a fixed signed projection, then interpolate to the common 10 ms head grid with edge hold. This does not add time resolution to the 20 ms input representations.

parent_method.data: Train two independent directions. Each sees the synthetic substitutions and same-word resampling from just one generator plus shared genuine controls. Match dry and noisy training within each prompt. The operating-point readers and held readers are separate from fitting.
parent_method.held: Each direction scores the generator that contributed no training positives. Keep speakers and meeting captures outside fit/calibration. Report distinct locations, matched-control collisions, false alarms (including the isolated backgrounds), and misses. Compare original PCM to the current timed review, and earlier saved whole-model methods only on their own cohorts.
parent_method.inputs: Use centered 25 ms frames every 10 ms and fixed 64 triangular Mel power bands. Standardize each band using only the respective fit pool. Teach exact per-frame content labels and splice edges within 30 ms. Optimize binary losses, paired synthetic-versus-genuine rankings, and consistency of the local margins between the dry and loud competing-speech views.
parent_method.points: Use only genuine files from the calibration readers, excluding the other generator's resampling. Seal one strict cutoff at the maximum genuine score and one wider cutoff at the 95th percentile of genuine foreground scores, bounded below by the highest background-only score. Both use a strict comparison. Cutoffs are shared across dry and noisy views and are not probabilities.
parent_method.readout: Propose .50, .75 and 1.00 s intervals every 100 ms. Use mean content response plus 0.15 times the mean of the strongest learned edge responses within 40 ms of the two endpoints. Require at least half detected speech and return the strongest span, with earlier/shorter ties.

method.projection: NumPy PCG64 seed 611407. Signed projections with orthogonal columns from reduced QR, taking 22, 21 and 21 columns from the three layers. No source-dependent fit.
method.readout: Report matched-control ordering, localization, ordinary and isolated-background alerts, and unassessed files for each held generator. Compare to the unchanged log-Mel and app checks.
